node.statement: Conditional composition step. Assume epsilon<=e_0/2 and rho<=a_merge=e_0/2. Then e=rho+epsilon<=e_0. Once nodes 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.2, and 1.3 are validated, mu_1, Gamma_1, and alpha_1 are linear bijections, gamma=alpha_1 Gamma_1 mu_1 is bijective, gamma_n=I_n tensor gamma, and every gamma_n has the homomorphism and two-sided norm bounds with constant C_merge=max{K_hom,K_norm,3}; this is exactly an extended C_merge*e-isomorphism. This conclusion is expressly conditional on the added epsilon bound and therefore does not establish the current root contract.
